content.label: Smart Agriculture & Predictive Farming
content.description: Monitoring kelembaban tanah, suhu & kelembaban udara, intensitas cahaya, dan prediksi irigasi berbasis ESP8266 + InfluxDB v2.

queries.text: from(bucket: "agriculture") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "agriculture" and r._field == "soil_moisture") |> last()
queries.name: soil_moisture

properties.note: Kelembaban tanah kapasitif (0-100%). Di bawah 30% butuh irigasi.
